Description: Control Music Assistant from your Stream Deck: every speaker, every streaming service, one deck.
Name: Music Assistant Controller

Localization.Next, previous, shuffle, repeat, crossfa: Next, previous, shuffle, repeat, crossfade or “Don't stop the music”.
Volume up, down, mute or a preset.
Localization.Add the current track to your favorites,: Add the current track to your favorites, or remove it.
Localization.Play a playlist, album, radio station or: Play a playlist, album, radio station or podcast from your library.
Localization.Resume your latest audiobook or podcast: Resume your latest audiobook or podcast episode where you left off.
Localization.Cover, title and progress on the display: Cover, title and progress on the display. Rotate to seek.
Localization.Volume on a dial, with mute and a preset: Volume on a dial, with mute and a preset.
Localization.Browse all providers or your library wit: Browse all providers or your library with the dial and play what you find.
Localization.Make this room the active player — and b: Make this room the active player — and bring the music along.
Localization.Choose the active player with the dial a: Choose the active player with the dial and bring the music there.
Localization.Scroll through the queue and jump to any: Scroll through the queue and jump to any track.
Volume of the whole speaker group.
Localization.Ambient effects spanning neighbouring di: Ambient effects spanning neighbouring dials, tinted by the cover.
Localization.Stop the music after 15, 30, 60 or 90 mi: Stop the music after 15, 30, 60 or 90 minutes.
Speak a message on one or all speakers.
Localization.Switch a speaker to an input like Line-i: Switch a speaker to an input like Line-in or TV.
Localization.Show a Music Assistant dashboard on a TV: Show a Music Assistant dashboard on a TV or screen.

pi.show_progress_hint: Bar in the color of the cover
pi.preview_auth_failed: No connection: the server rejected the token.
pi.setup_sub: Once — then every MAC key works.
pi.server_url_hint: IP of your Music Assistant server. As a Home Assistant add-on: the IP of Home Assistant, port 8095.
pi.token_hint: In Music Assistant: Settings → Profile → create a long-lived token, e.g. “Stream Deck”.
pi.token_rejected_hint: Check that the token was copied completely and still exists in Music Assistant. You can create a new one under Settings → Profile.
pi.active_player_hint: Applies to all MAC keys. Keys set to “Active player” control this player.
pi.cmd_skip_hint: Dimmed while a live radio stream plays: there is nothing to skip.
pi.cmd_repeat_hint: Each press cycles: off → all → one.
pi.cmd_dont_stop_hint: When the queue ends, Music Assistant keeps playing similar music.
pi.cmd_crossfade_hint: Music Assistant only crossfades in flow mode (a player setting in Music Assistant, switchable here). Switching it briefly restarts what is playing. Tracks from the same album are never crossfaded unless allowed in Music Assistant's settings. With Spotify, tracks may fail to play in flow mode.
pi.vol_show_value_hint: The current volume on the key (in the ring on the mute key)
pi.like_hint: The heart is filled when the current track or station already is a favorite. Pressing adds or removes it.
pi.item_no_favorites: No favorites yet — search above for anything to play.
pi.opt_hint_replace: Replaces the queue and starts playing right away.
pi.opt_hint_add: Adds to the end of the queue.
pi.show_item_name_hint: Name of the item on the key
pi.dial_volume_rotate: Rotate: volume · Push: mute · Touch: preset (hold to save the current volume)
pi.dial_track_rotate: Rotate: seek · Push: next track · Touch: play / pause
pi.show_volume_text_hint: Number in the ring, player name next to it
pi.ring_cover_color_hint: The ring takes the main color of what is playing
pi.dial_browser_help: Rotate: scroll · Push: open folder / play · Touch: back (hold: back to start)
pi.transfer_hint: If the previous active player is playing, the music moves here.
pi.show_cover_hint: Shows what plays in this room
pi.player_key_help: Press: this player becomes the active player — all keys set to “Active player” follow.
pi.player_dial_help: Rotate: choose the active player · Push: bring the music here from wherever it plays · Touch: play / pause
pi.dial_queue_help: Rotate: scroll the queue (starts at the current track) · Push: play the selected track · Touch: back to the current track
pi.dial_group_help: Rotate: volume of the whole group · Push: mute the group · Touch: preset (hold to save). Without a group it controls the player alone.
pi.queue_timeout: Back to the current track after
pi.show_title_hint: Title and artist scroll along the key
pi.background_hint: Neighbouring dials with the same effect share one continuous scene.
pi.sync_effect_hint: Changing the effect here also switches the neighboring displays that run the same effect. Choosing none takes only this display out.
pi.cover_color_hint: Tint the effect with the colors of what is playing
pi.panorama_help: Rotate and push change the effect (e.g. speed). Put several Panorama dials — or Track/Volume dials with the same background — next to each other for one scene across the whole touch strip.
pi.overlay_hint: Shows what the chosen player plays. Neighbouring Panorama dials share one line across their displays.
pi.lyrics_hint: Synced lyrics come from Music Assistant's metadata providers (e.g. LRCLIB). Without lyrics, title and artist are shown. The line shows up half a second before it is sung. Lyrics too early or too late? Move the timing left or right.
pi.sleep_help: Each press sets the next duration; after the last one the timer switches off. The key counts down the minutes left.
pi.sleep_steps_hint: Comma-separated minutes, stepped through with each press.
pi.announce_no_engines: No TTS engine found — add one in Home Assistant or Music Assistant.
pi.announce_chime_hint: A short sound before the message
pi.announce_volume_hint: Volume 0 % keeps each speaker's current volume.
pi.source_help: Switches the player to this input. The key lights up while the input is active.
pi.no_sources: This player has no selectable inputs.
pi.dashboard_help: Press to show the dashboard on the screen, press again to take it down.
pi.no_screens: No screen found. Chromecast devices appear here once Music Assistant knows them.
pi.continue_help: Shows the audiobook or podcast episode you started most recently. Press to continue where you left off, press again to pause.
